description: Write to ALL the users of an app, or to the members of one group (optionally only one role in it): the message lands in each one's inbox as a message from the developer (neblla.inbox; a connected user gets it live, inbox.on('updated') with action "created"). It is paid per recipient from the app's daily quota, like any message (msgFixedOut + the bytes of message and data, kind newCommunication). action "estimate" { message, data?, group?, role? } says beforehand what it will cost: recipients, credits, what is left today (available), percentOfDay and how many that reaches (reachable) — ALWAYS show this to the developer and get their OK before "send". "send" (same fields) answers at once and sends in the background in batches; it never goes past the quota: when the day's quota runs out it stops (status "stopped_quota", with resumesAt), raises the app alert broadcast_paused and goes on by itself from there after the 00:00 UTC reset; "resume" { id } goes on sooner once there is quota (a pack). "status" { id } and "list" show how far each send got (sent, skipped: terminated / inboxFull / gone). One send at a time per app (broadcast_running). Needs the inbox module (feature_disabled otherwise). You speak to their users on their behalf: confirm the exact wording first.

group.description: Only the members of this group (neblla_group); omit for every user

role.description: With group: only the members with this role

name: neblla_broadcast
